item.title: Version 1.6.3
item.changes: Shapes, lines, marquee selections and resized layers show their size beside the pointer as you drag New View › Show › Distances shows pixel gaps to the canvas edges and nearby layers while moving a layer, and to the layer under the pointer with ⌘ held Deselect (⌘D) works after clicking the same area twice with the Magic Wand Volumetric Light's color picker samples from the canvas instead of moving the light The "Automatically download and install updates" checkbox in the update alert can be checked again
